protocol: Each trial isolates one term. Record what the Stat Meter and the screen show, not a conclusion: the exact item and prefix, the target (a stationary dummy for the hit clock, the stage's boss for uptime), the distance held, the shown damage and crit, the trial length in seconds, the raw hit count or non-crit damage total, how long the projectile visibly overlapped the target, how many projectiles were out, single target or crowd. Three to five runs per mechanic, mean and spread. A held projectile with no local immunity tests the 10-tick fallback; one with a known local cooldown is the control that must reproduce 60/local. Uptime is a moving-boss trial, measured apart from the clock. A rogue is four trials: continuous spam, one isolated strike, recharge while idle and while moving, and an alternating schedule.

trials.name: Mycoroot
trials.note: post-Crabulon, seven minutes of continuous use against The Excavator, the meter dead steady at 202. Three tooltips off the same character, Flawless Mycoroot: 15 damage / 13% crit bare, 17 / 27% with accessories only (3x Menacing = +12%, so the accessories add no damage of their own), 70 / 33% with everything at full stealth (armour is +10% damage and +6% crit, which the crit column confirms exactly). The Stat Meter read 233.72% thrower damage on armour alone at full stealth, and the model predicts 234.01% - that is stealthMultiplier reproduced against the game. It also read Max Stealth 65, Standing Regen 10.53/s, Moving Regen 5.27/s, which is rogueStealthMax / BaseStealthGenTime x 1.08 x 60: a display figure carrying the wrong constant, and evidence of the Silent reforge (+8% accStealthGenBoost), NOT of the fill clock - UpdateRogueStealth is 'rogueStealth += rogueStealthMax * gen / 120' a tick, so the bar fills in 2 s standing and 4 s moving. The x1.15 is the reforge second multiplier (RogueWeaponPrefix.stealthDmgMult, applied by CalamityPlayer.ModifyWeaponDamage only while StealthStrikeAvailable), and with it in the model gives 195 DPS against the measured 202 - but it needs a re-mine, because the prefix extractor only learned to read stealthDmgMult with this trial. STILL OPEN: the tooltip 70. The model says 14 x (1 + 0.22 gear + 1.24 stealth) x 1.15 = 40, and the player has confirmed no Rage and no Adrenaline were up, so the x1.75 has no name yet. What closes it: the Stat Meter Damage percentage read at the same instant as a 70 tooltip - if it is ~240% the gap is item-level (ModifyWeaponDamage and friends), if it is ~435% it is player-level and belongs in the additive pool
